products.name: Microsoft Edge for Business — Enterprise Configuration & Security Baseline (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn Microsoft Edge into a managed, hardened, standardized browser across your Windows fleet via Intune — password manager off, Edge enforced as default, SmartScreen/PUA, extension control, IE mode for legacy apps, and the Microsoft Edge security baseline. Resolves two common assessment findings and hardens your most-used app. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop shipping Edge at its out-of-the-box defaults

An unmanaged browser is the single most-used piece of software on every endpoint — and it usually runs wide open: the built-in password manager competes with your corporate vault, Edge isn't enforced as the default browser, SmartScreen and PUA protection are unmanaged, extensions install freely, and there's no Enterprise Mode Site List so legacy line-of-business apps limp along. Security assessments flag the first two directly. This solution turns Microsoft Edge into a managed, hardened, standardized browser across your Windows fleet using Microsoft Intune — the Settings Catalog (Microsoft Edge ADMX-backed) for configuration and the Microsoft Edge security baseline for the hardening floor — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered Intune steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named (Edge for Business - Baseline - Pilot) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What it configures

  • Edge as the default browser org-wide — a Windows default-associations configuration delivered via Intune, plus IE mode with an Enterprise Mode Site List so legacy IE-dependent apps keep working inside Edge.
  • Password manager off — PasswordManagerEnabled = Disabled, steering users to your enterprise password solution.
  • A pragmatic security baseline — SmartScreen + PUA on, block/allow-list extensions (control sideloading), sync & work-profile sign-in controls, website typo protection (typosquatting), a defined update channel & cadence, managed startup/home pages — then the Microsoft Edge security baseline layered on top.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the two Intune surfaces (Settings Catalog + Endpoint security baseline), how default-browser enforcement and IE mode work, and the named objects you build and reuse.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Edge installed, Settings Catalog access, enterprise password solution, Enterprise Mode Site List, default-associations XML, pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named Settings Catalog baseline, enforce the default browser, apply the Microsoft Edge security baseline, configure IE mode, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a coverage report, safe remediation of a missing/mis-scoped baseline, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (both findings resolved, IE mode renders, extensions controlled, conflict handling via edge://policy) plus Best Practices for Settings-Catalog vs security-baseline conflicts.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A browser that is default, standardized, and hardened on every Windows endpoint — the two assessment findings resolved and legacy apps kept alive through IE mode — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation and targeting default to a safe preview):
    • EDGEBIZ-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for the Microsoft Edge for Business baseline
    • EDGEBIZ-Remediation.ps1 — safely create/fix the Edge Settings Catalog baseline (password manager off, SmartScreen on)
    • EDGEBIZ-Report.ps1 — coverage report for the Edge baseline across Windows devices
    • EDGEBIZ-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for the Edge baseline profile
    • EDGEBIZ-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device applied state of the Edge baseline

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
